# AbstractCore

> Unified Python interface for cloud and local LLMs: generation, streaming, host-controlled tools, typed output, sessions, media, embeddings and OpenAI-compatible HTTP serving.

Package version: 2.31.0
Supported Python: 3.9+; CI tests Python 3.9–3.13.

Use an explicit provider, exact model and endpoint. Local model loads are offline/cache-first;
download weights deliberately. Tools are pass-through by default: the host authorizes and
executes calls. For durable agent orchestration, use [AbstractRuntime](https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractruntime).

## Agent Skill

- [AbstractCore skill](skills/abstractcore/SKILL.md): portable operating procedure for agents writing integrations and piloting an installation; keep its references folder.
- [Python recipes](skills/abstractcore/references/integrations.md): sessions, typed extraction, streaming, async, allowlisted tools, embeddings and media.
- [Operating recipes](skills/abstractcore/references/operations.md): endpoint discovery, models, engines, serving, caches and diagnostics.

## Python Integrations

- [Tool calling](docs/tool-calling.md): native/prompted syntax, tool definitions and host execution.
- [Tool rewriting](docs/tool-syntax-rewriting.md): tags and agent_format for clients.
- [Structured output](docs/structured-output.md): response_model, validation and retry budgets.
- [Generation parameters](docs/generation-parameters.md): token/sampling defaults and caller overrides.
- [Reasoning](docs/reasoning-control.md): thinking controls, effort transports and effective metadata.
- [Sessions](docs/session.md): history and persistence.
- [Prompt caching](docs/prompt-caching.md): backend capability matrix, stable prefixes, hit metadata and measured limits.
- [Async](docs/async-guide.md): asynchronous generation and streaming.
- [Concurrency](docs/concurrency.md): async versus backend batching.
- [Media input](docs/media-handling-system.md): images, documents, audio/video policies and fallbacks.
- [Request and output](docs/request-output.md): canonical multimodal request/output contract.
- [Capabilities](docs/capabilities.md): voice, vision, music, 3D and camera plugins; supported boundaries; voices by engine and language, voice design, cloned-voice management.
- [Vision](docs/vision-capabilities.md): native image/video input and captioning fallbacks.
- [Glyph compression](docs/glyphs.md): vision-based document compression and tradeoffs.
- [Embeddings](docs/embeddings.md): local/remote vectors and the embedding.text route.
- [MCP](docs/mcp.md): discover tool servers over HTTP/stdio; dispatch in the host.
- [Examples](examples/README.md): runnable examples by task and a guided learning path.

## Operating the Host

- [Local models](docs/models.md): catalog/fit, exact artifacts, downloads, jobs, deletion and verification.
- [Knowledge-graph extraction models](docs/knowledge-graph-extraction-models.md): measured local vs hosted model comparison for ontology-constrained extraction, prompt rules and second-pass strategies.
- [Recommended models](docs/recommended-models.md): capability choices by platform and memory.
- [Engines](docs/engines.md): inventory, install plans and platform support.
- [Configuration](docs/centralized-config.md): persistent routes, endpoint profiles, credentials and timeouts.
- [Server](docs/server.md): multi-provider /v1 endpoints, authentication and control planes.
- [Endpoint](docs/endpoint.md): one provider/model per HTTP worker.
- [Web console](docs/console.md): model/engine/config management through the browser.
- [Terminal console](docs/console-tui.md): terminal host management.
- [Chat CLI](docs/acore-cli.md): interactive conversations.
- [Memory and residency](docs/memory-management.md): loaded models, ownership, unload and memory accounting.
- [Memory blocs](docs/memory-blocs.md): text snapshots and native KV artifacts with live-binding checks.
- [Cancellation](docs/generation-cancel.md): cancel_event, per-lane support and safe eject.
- [HF compatibility](docs/huggingface-model-compatibility.md): Transformers/GGUF artifacts and loading limits.
- [Speculation](docs/speculative-decoding.md): native MTP controls and checkpoint support.
- [Native MLX](docs/native-mlx-runtime.md): opt-in scheduling, MTP, caching and cancellation.
- [MLX benchmarks](docs/native-mlx-benchmarks.md): measurements and comparison scope.
- [Fallbacks](docs/fallbacks.md): explicit compatibility behavior; no model-artifact substitution.
- [Events](docs/events.md): observability hooks.
- [Logging](docs/structured-logging.md): log configuration.
- [Tracing](docs/interaction-tracing.md): opt-in prompt/response/usage capture.
- [Email](docs/email.md): account configuration, Read only or Read and write access (`EmailAccount.access`, `set_access`), mailbox verbs, recipient policy and read/send tools.
